frequency_vs_reuse_gap_correlation.note: descriptive monotonic-association measure only; no causal interpretation, no predictor claim (section 17).

r2_05_bridge_note: R2-05 showed frequency concentration. Being frequent is a logically distinct property from being reused soon; R2-07 computes a secondary, descriptive Spearman correlation between request frequency and median token reuse gap to characterize, not causally explain, this distinction.
r2_06_bridge_note: R2-06 identified immediate (one-step) conditional routing structure. R2-07 measures the temporal horizon and working-set consequences of that structure -- R2-06's finding does not by itself establish long-range locality; R2-07 is what tests that.
